verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an SDK/API reference page that lists features such as auto-instrumentation, tracing decorators and span querying. Nothing in the pack says that reference is interactive or has runnable "try it" examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. A static SDK reference is adjacent material, not the interactive runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
